_comment: Dagar tutor golden set. Design, criteria and how to add a case: docs/EVALS.md. Every case carries a `source`: real (verbatim from a learner, 6 to 9 Aug 2026), synthetic (written to fill a thin cell in a taxonomy the real data produced), adversarial (deliberate attack), regression (a defect we actually shipped). Criteria are written so each can be satisfied independently of the others.

message: 17 answer hai
must: Does not open with praise such as good, well done or nice
Does not say or imply the answer is correct
why: 8 Aug: the tutor replied 'Good, you're working through it' to an answer typed at it, which reads as confirmation and breaks the never-grade rule.

message: Where to select answers 🤔

Does not explain tally marks or any other concept
